finalText:
**Green now.** 625 tests pass, 0 fail.

Only 3 cases were ever broken. All three were in `orderTotal`.

It took the coupon off the price, then charged tax on the *old* price. The comment above it already said tax goes on the discounted amount. The code just didn't. Now it taxes what the customer actually pays.

Most rows had a zero coupon or zero tax, so they hid it. `verify.js` also passes.
